jobs.title: Strategic Planning Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
About the role
 Are you energized by complexity, motivated by purpose, and excited by the opportunity to shape supply planning for a product in a pivotal growth phase? As Strategic Planning Manager for you will play a central role in ensuring robust product availability across Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished Goods. Working across the full supply chain, you will translate commercial and medical priorities into clear, executable plans, navigate uncertainty with confidence, and help steer key decisions that directly support patients living with rare diseases.
 This role offers broad visibility and impact, spanning strategic long-term planning, tactical decision-making, and day-to-day supply assurance.
 You will join our Global Supply Operations team, report to the Head of Planning, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.

In this role, you will:

• Own and continuously evolve the integrated end-to-end supply plan across short-, mid- and long-term horizons, balancing commercial and medical demand, inventory strategy and supply capabilities.

• Lead scenario planning and supply risk assessments, translating uncertainty into clear options, recommendations and decision material for governance and senior stakeholders.

• Turn demand signals into capacity, material and inventory requirements, and drive alignment on assumptions and commitments across key planning cycles.

• Shape allocation and supply prioritization proposals when demand exceeds supply, ensuring transparent trade-offs and strong alignment across markets, indications and programs.

• Partner closely with Commercial, Medical, TechOps, Quality, Regulatory, Global Distribution and external partners to create one aligned, executable plan.

• Prepare and present planning insights, risks and mitigation plans in product teams and governance forums, acting as a trusted voice on supply planning and constraints.

• Establish meaningful planning KPIs and continuously improve ways of working, data quality and tools to strengthen planning performance over time.

About you
 You are someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and brings calm, structure and sound judgement when complexity is high. You enjoy working across functions and geographies, influencing without formal authority, and turning ambiguity into clear direction. Just as importantly, you are motivated by meaningful work and excited by the opportunity to help secure supply for patients who rely on innovative treatment options.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A university degree in engineering, supply chain, business, finance or a related field.

• Significant experience in end-to-end supply planning within pharma, biotech or another highly regulated and complex supply chain environment.

• A strong track record of building integrated demand and supply plans, leading scenario planning, and navigating supply constraints and prioritization decisions.

• Experience working cross-functionally with close exposure to Commercial and/or Medical organizations, ideally in launch, access or demand-shaping environments.

• An advanced degree, MBA, or experience in launch planning, indication expansion, partnership supply chains or capacity expansion projects would be an advantage

• Strong end-to-end planning expertise, including S&OP, supply planning, inventory strategy, capacity planning and scenario management.

• The ability to translate complex data into clear insights, business decisions and practical actions.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior forums and driving alignment under pressure.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel capabilities and experience with planning or analytics systems such as Kinaxis Maestro or Power BI considered a plus.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Descrizione Sei eccitato dalla complessità, motivato dallo scopo, ed eccitato dall'opportunità di plasmare la pianificazione dell'offerta per un prodotto in una fase di crescita cardine? Come Strategic Planning Manager per voi giocherà un ruolo centrale nel garantire la robusta disponibilità del prodotto attraverso la sostanza della droga, il prodotto della droga e i beni finiti. Lavorando in tutta la catena di fornitura, tradurre le priorità commerciali e mediche in piani chiari, eseguibili, navigare in incertezza con fiducia e aiutare a guidare decisioni chiave che supportano direttamente i pazienti che vivono con malattie rare. Questo ruolo offre ampia visibilità e impatto, che spaziano dalla pianificazione strategica a lungo termine, dal processo decisionale tattico e dall'assicurazione della fornitura quotidiana. Ti unirai al nostro team di Global Supply Operations, farai rapporto al capo della pianificazione, e ti troverai al nostro quartier generale di Stoccolma o Global Hub di Basilea. Mansioni - Proprio ed evolve continuamente il piano di fornitura end-to-end integrato attraverso orizzonti a breve, a metà e a lungo termine, bilanciando la domanda commerciale e medica, la strategia di inventario e le capacità di approvvigionamento. - Guidare la pianificazione dello scenario e fornire valutazioni dei rischi, traducendo l'incertezza in opzioni chiare, raccomandazioni e materiale decisionale per la governance e gli stakeholder senior. - Trasformare i segnali della domanda in requisiti di capacità, materiale e inventario, e guidare l'allineamento su assunzioni e impegni attraverso i cicli di pianificazione chiave. - Proposte di assegnazione e priorità dell'offerta quando la domanda supera l'offerta, garantendo scambi trasparenti e un forte allineamento su mercati, indicazioni e programmi. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con partner commerciali, medici, tecnici, qualità, regolamentazione, distribuzione globale e esterni per creare un piano allineato, eseguibile. - Preparare e presentare intuizioni di pianificazione, rischi e piani di mitigazione nei team di prodotti e forum di governance, agendo come voce attendibile sulla pianificazione e vincoli di approvvigionamento. - Stabilire KPI di pianificazione significativa e migliorare continuamente modi di lavoro, qualità dei dati e strumenti per rafforzare le prestazioni di pianificazione nel tempo.
• Requisiti - Una laurea in ingegneria, supply chain, business, finanza o un campo correlato. - Esperienza significativa nella pianificazione end-to-end dell'offerta all'interno di farmaci, biotecnologie o un altro ambiente di supply chain altamente regolamentato e complesso. - Un forte record di costruzione di piani integrati di domanda e di approvvigionamento, pianificazione di scenari leader, e la navigazione di vincoli di fornitura e decisioni di priorità. - Esperienza di lavoro interfunzionale con un'esposizione ravvicinata a organizzazioni commerciali e/o mediche, idealmente in ambienti di lancio, di accesso o di modellazione della domanda. - Un grado avanzato, MBA, o esperienza nella pianificazione del lancio, espansione delle indicazioni, catene di fornitura di partnership o progetti di espansione della capacità sarebbe un vantaggio. - Forte esperienza di pianificazione end-to-end, tra cui S&OP, pianificazione della fornitura, strategia di inventario, pianificazione della capacità e gestione dello scenario. - La capacità di tradurre dati complessi in chiare intuizioni, decisioni aziendali e azioni pratiche. - Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di comunicazione, con fiducia presentando forum senior e allineamento di guida sotto pressione. - Forte capacità di problem solving analitico e strutturato, con funzionalità avanzate di Excel e l'esperienza con sistemi di pianificazione o analisi come Kinaxis Maestro o Power BI considerato un plus. - Inglese fluente, sia scritto che parlato; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. Cosa? - Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team - Opportunità di crescita professionale - Diversità e inclusione - Compensazione competitiva per il tuo lavoro - Fare un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti con malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti salvavita - enfasi sul lavoro/equilibrio della vita Sobi Cultura A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli. Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo obiettivo come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che li curano. Questo è stato il nostro approccio dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. L'integrazione richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile. Contatto Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso in questo reclutamento e vi chiediamo di inviare la vostra domanda il prima possibile. Fare clic su applicare e includere il tuo curriculum in inglese.

Beschreibung Sie werden von Komplexität angeregt, zielstrebig motiviert und begeistert von der Möglichkeit, die Angebotsplanung für ein Produkt in einer entscheidenden Wachstumsphase zu gestalten? Als Strategischer Planungsmanager für Sie wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gewährleistung einer robusten Produktverfügbarkeit über Drogenstoffe, Arzneimittel und Fertigwaren spielen. In der gesamten Lieferkette werden Sie kommerzielle und medizinische Prioritäten in klare, ausführbare Pläne übersetzen, Unsicherheit mit Vertrauen navigieren und wichtige Entscheidungen steuern, die Patienten mit seltenen Krankheiten direkt unterstützen. Diese Rolle bietet eine breite Sichtbarkeit und Wirkung, die strategische langfristige Planung, taktische Entscheidungsfindung und tägliche Versorgungssicherheit umfasst. Sie werden sich unserem Global Supply Operations Team anschließen, dem Leiter der Planung berichten und auf unserem Stockholm HQ oder Global Hub in Basel basieren. Mansion - Eigener und kontinuierlicher Ausbau des integrierten End-to-End-Versorgungsplans über kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Horizonte, Ausgleich der kommerziellen und medizinischen Nachfrage, Inventarstrategie und Versorgungsfähigkeiten. - Führen Sie Szenarienplanung und Risikobewertungen, Übersetzen von Unsicherheit in klare Optionen, Empfehlungen und Entscheidungsmaterial für Governance und Senior Stakeholder. - Wenden Sie die Nachfrage in Kapazitäts-, Material- und Inventaranforderungen und treiben Sie die Ausrichtung auf Annahmen und Verpflichtungen in Schlüsselplanungszyklen. - Form-Zuweisungs- und Angebotspriorisierungsvorschläge, wenn die Nachfrage das Angebot übersteigt, transparente Abschlüsse und eine starke Ausrichtung auf Märkte, Indikationen und Programme gewährleistet. - Partner eng mit kommerziellen, medizinischen, TechOps, Qualität, Regulierung, Global Distribution und externen Partnern zusammen, um einen ausgerichteten, ausführbaren Plan zu erstellen. - Planen Sie Einblicke, Risiken und Minderungspläne in Produktteams und Governance-Foren vor und präsentieren Sie als vertrauenswürdige Stimme zur Angebotsplanung und -zwänge. - Stellen Sie aussagekräftige Planungskennzahlen fest und verbessern Sie kontinuierlich die Arbeits-, Datenqualität und Werkzeuge, um die Planungsleistung im Laufe der Zeit zu stärken. Voraussetzungen - Ein Hochschulabschluss in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Finance oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Kennzeichnende Erfahrung in der End-to-End-Versorgungsplanung in Pharma, Biotech oder einer anderen hochregulierten und komplexen Lieferkettenumgebung. - Eine starke Erfolgsbilanz des Aufbaus integrierter Nachfrage- und Angebotspläne, führender Szenarienplanung und navigieren von Angebotsbeschränkungen und Priorisierungsentscheidungen. - Erleben Sie funktionsübergreifend mit einer engen Exposition gegenüber kommerziellen und/oder medizinischen Organisationen, ideal in Start-, Zugangs- oder bedarfsorientierten Umgebungen. - Ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss, MBA oder Erfahrung in der Startplanung, Indikationserweiterung, Partnerschaft Lieferketten oder Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte wäre ein Vorteil. - Starke Planungskompetenz, einschließlich S&OP, Versorgungsplanung, Inventarstrategie, Kapazitätsplanung und Szenariomanagement. - Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in klare Einblicke, Geschäftsentscheidungen und praktische Handlungen zu übersetzen. - Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen präsentieren Senior Foren und Fahrausrichtung unter Druck. - Starke analytische und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, mit erweiterten Excel-Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit Planungs- oder Analysesystemen wie Kinaxis Maestro oder Power BI betrachteten ein Plus. - fließendes Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.

Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, denen seltene Krankheiten ausgesetzt sind, aus erster Hand erlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Geschäft zu gestalten, um neue Wege zu finden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen verwandeln, helfen wir, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Möglichkeiten für die Pflege für sie zu eröffnen. Dies ist unser Ansatz seit dem ersten Tag, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht allein verändern können. Dazu kommen starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Stakeholdern in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der Betroffenen von seltenen Krankheiten dienen und ein nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen. Descrizione Êtes-vous stimulé par la complexité, motivé par le but, et excité par la possibilité de façonner la planification d'approvisionnement pour un produit dans une phase de croissance pivot? En tant que gestionnaire de la planification stratégique pour vous, vous jouerez un rôle central pour assurer une disponibilité solide des produits dans l'ensemble des substances médicamenteuses, des produits pharmaceutiques et des produits finis. En travaillant sur l'ensemble de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous allez traduire les priorités commerciales et médicales en plans clairs et exécutables, naviguer l'incertitude avec confiance et aider à orienter les décisions clés qui soutiennent directement les patients atteints de maladies rares. Ce rôle offre une large visibilité et un impact, couvrant la planification stratégique à long terme, la prise de décisions tactiques et l'assurance de l'approvisionnement quotidien. Vous rejoindrez notre équipe d'opérations d'approvisionnement mondial, ferez rapport au Chef de la planification et serez basé à notre QG de Stockholm ou Global Hub à Bâle. Mansioni - Le plan intégré d'approvisionnement de bout en bout évolue lui-même et en permanence à court, à moyen et à long terme, en conciliant la demande commerciale et médicale, la stratégie d'inventaire et les capacités d'approvisionnement. - La planification des scénarios et l'évaluation des risques liés à l'offre, ce qui traduit l'incertitude en options claires, en recommandations et en documents décisionnels pour la gouvernance et les principaux intervenants. - Transformer les signaux de la demande en besoins en matière de capacité, de matériel et d'inventaire, et orienter l'alignement sur les hypothèses et les engagements pour les principaux cycles de planification. - Former les propositions d'attribution et de hiérarchisation de l'offre lorsque la demande dépasse l'offre, en assurant des compromis transparents et une forte harmonisation entre les marchés, les indications et les programmes. - S'associer étroitement avec des partenaires commerciaux, médicaux, techniques, de qualité, réglementaires, de distribution mondiale et externes pour créer un plan exécutable aligné. - Préparer et présenter des plans de planification, des risques et des plans d'atténuation dans les équipes de produits et les forums de gouvernance, agissant comme une voix de confiance sur la planification de l'offre et les contraintes. - Établir des ICR de planification valables et améliorer continuellement les méthodes de travail, la qualité des données et les outils pour renforcer le rendement de la planification au fil du temps.
• Requisiti - Un diplôme universitaire en ingénierie, chaîne d'approvisionnement, entreprise, finance ou un domaine connexe. - Expérience importante dans la planification d'approvisionnement de bout en bout au sein de la pharmacologie, de la biotechnologie ou d'un autre environnement hautement réglementé et complexe de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. - Une solide expérience en matière d'élaboration de plans intégrés de la demande et de l'offre, de planification des scénarios, de navigation des contraintes de l'offre et de choix des priorités. - Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec une exposition étroite aux organisations commerciales et/ou médicales, idéalement dans les environnements de lancement, d'accès ou de formation de la demande. - Un diplôme avancé, un MBA ou une expérience dans la planification de lancement, l'expansion des indications, les chaînes d'approvisionnement de partenariat ou les projets d'expansion des capacités serait un avantage. - Une solide expertise en planification de bout en bout, y compris en S-P, en planification des approvisionnements, en stratégie d'inventaire, en planification des capacités et en gestion des scénarios. - La capacité de traduire des données complexes en idées claires, décisions d'affaires et actions pratiques. - Excellente capacité de gestion et de communication des parties prenantes, avec confiance dans les forums de haut niveau et conduite de l'alignement sous pression. - Fortes compétences analytiques et structurées en résolution de problèmes, avec des capacités Excel avancées et une expérience avec des systèmes de planification ou d'analyse tels que Kinaxis Maestro ou Power BI considéré comme un plus. - L'anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé; d'autres langues sont un avantage.
• Cosa offriamo - Environnement collaboratif et axé sur l'équipe - Possibilités de croissance professionnelle - Diversité et inclusion - Compensation compétitive pour votre travail - Faire un impact positif pour aider les patients atteints de maladies ultra-rares qui ont besoin de traitements vitaux - Mettre l ' accent sur l ' équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée Culture sobi Chez Sobi, nous refusons le statu quo. C'est parce que nous avons été témoins de première main des défis auxquels sont confrontés les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et que nous avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider. En tant qu'entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous sommes dédiés aux maladies rares. Et nous voyons cet accent comme une force. En transformant efficacement nos recherches en traitements révolutionnaires, nous aidons à rendre la médecine plus accessible et à ouvrir davantage de possibilités aux patients et à ceux qui s'en occupent. C'est notre approche depuis le premier jour, mais nous savons que nous ne pouvons pas changer le monde des maladies rares nous-mêmes. Pour y parvenir, il faut établir des partenariats solides avec les patients, les partenaires et les intervenants dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Ensemble, nous définissons comment notre entreprise peut créer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des personnes touchées par des maladies rares tout en facilitant une croissance durable. jobs.description:
The IT department, a part of IS/IT, are responsible for architecture, strategy, maintenance and support of Sobi information systems and IT infrastructure as clients, servers, network and other infrastructure equipment.
 The IT department consist of four teams – IT Operations, Infrastructure & Cyber security, Digital Workplace and Automation & Integration.All IT activities are performed in accordance with Sobi’s quality framework (GxP) and applicable regulatory and authority requirements.
 Within this context, the Digital Workplace & AI function plays a key role in enabling secure, compliant, and scalable digital solutions across Sobi. Under the leadership of the Head of Digital Workplace & AI, the team is responsible for developing and advancing Sobi’s Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365 platform, and enterprise AI capabilities. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and delivering modern, AI-enabled tools that support collaboration, productivity, and innovation across the organization.
 Main responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain enterprise-grade AI applications built on Azure OpenAI, including chat interfaces, document processing pipelines (RAG), and real-time collaboration features

jobs.description:
The role will lead the global development and execution of the global brand communications strategy for Tryngolza , ensuring strong, compliant, and impactful communication.
 Partnering across Brand Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical, Community Engagement, Investor Relations, Regulatory, Compliance, Legal and Finance, plus regional teams and affiliate teams, you’ll translate strategy into high quality, scalable activation while strengthening global visibility, media impact, and affiliate execution.
 This is a senior individual contributor leadership role designed to own brand communications and lead critical workstreams, in close collaboration with the overall asset leadership team.
 Key responsibilities :
 Strategic Leadership & Brand Communications,

• Lead the global brand communications strategy, including launch readiness, data milestone planning, and lifecycle communications

• Maintain the brand narrative consistently across all channels and stakeholders
 Media Strategy, Relationship & External Engagement

• Partner with Disease State Awareness lead on product media strategy, including channel selection, prioritization, and media investment (paid, earned, and owned)

• Build and manage relationships with key international and specialty media

• Guide affiliates in local media engagement, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality
 Congress Communications & Activation

• Lead the brand congress communications roadmap (pre-, during-, and post-congress)

• Oversee development of global congress toolkits and ensure strong local amplification across markets

• Coordinate Support cross-functional alignment (Medical, IR, Compliance) for data communication and own media engagement
 Global-to-Local Execution & Affiliate Enablement

• Develop and deploy global communication toolkits, digital assets, and campaign playbooks for affiliate use

• Oversee development of high-quality communication materials, including narratives, Q&As, digital content, and presentations

• Partner closely with country teams to strengthen capabilities and drive high-quality execution

• Lead agency management, ensuring strategic alignment, quality delivery, and efficient execution
 Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Medical and Brand teams to ensure scientific integrity and strong educational impact

• Collaborate with Community Engagement to amplify the patient voice and strengthen external partnerships

• Align with Corporate/IR Communications to ensure consistency and clarity of external messaging
 Insights, Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Lead global insight gathering (media landscape, social listening, advisory boards) to inform strategy

• Define and track KPIs to measure communication effectiveness and optimize impact

• Continuously refine communication approaches based on data, insights, and evolving market dynamics
 Capability Building & Innovation

• Drive continuous improvement of communications capabilities across international markets

• Introduce and scale best practices data-driven communications and promote the use of new tools, including AI, to enhance efficiency, personalization, and impact
 Budget, Governance & Compliance
 Manage the budget for communication programs; forecast, track ROI, and reallocate for impact while operating to SOPs, industry codes, and corporate values

• Proven experience in brand communications/PR within healthcare, including significant experience in pharmaceutical or biotech environment.

• Demonstrated success in leading complex, multi-market communications strategies at regional or global level.

• Strong strategic mindset with the ability to translate business priorities into impactful communications and reputation initiatives.

• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally, lead without authority, and manage complexity.

• Strong relationship builder, capable of fostering trusted partnerships across functions (Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Policy, Patient Advocacy) and across country affiliates.

• Excellent communication and influence across functions, cultures, and seniority levels; fluent in English.

• Excellent judgment and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• High energy, creativity, agility and a proactive, solutions‑orientated mindset.

• Strong team player with the ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and accountability.

• Proficiency with approval systems and compliant content workflows (e.g., Veeva).

• Proficiency in digital and modern communication tools; familiarity with AI-enabled content development within company policies is an asset

• Travel requirement approximately 20% of working time

• Eccellenti capacità di giudizio e decisionali, con la capacità di stabilire le priorità in ambienti dinamici e frenetici.
• Alta energia, creatività, agilità e una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni.

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Overall accountability for quantitative clinical pharmacology strategies and activities in appointed clinical projects with focus on late-stage development including filing and life-cycle management.

• Define appropriate strategies for clinical pharmacology/translational medicine, clinical PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, and M&S in clinical development plans that enable clinical development and regulatory decisions.

• Provide matrix leadership to collaborate, align and influence across the cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate key project challenges related to the clinical pharmacology discipline.

• Provide expert knowledge on clinical pharmacology and communicate clinical pharmacology aspects internally and during health authority interactions.

• Oversee that Model Based Drug Development (MBDD) is applied in clinical programs when clinically relevant.

• Ensure that translational aspects are considered and that pre-clinical and clinical PK/PD information are optimally used and integrated into development plans.

• Contribute and decide on the biomarker strategy in clinical programs.

• Contribute to the clinical development plan.

• Responsible for clinical pharmacology sections in regulatory documents and at interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Represent clinical pharmacology on project Core Teams.

• Contribute to clinical pharmacology evaluations at in-licensing and due-diligence activities.

• Ph.D. in relevant scientific area and 8 years of experience in clinical pharmacology (preferably in the pharmaceutical industry) or a minimum of Master´s degree in relevant scientific area with 10 years of experience in clinical pharmacology (preferably in the pharmaceutical industry).

• Solid understanding of the drug-development process and challenges specific to clinical pharmacology.

• Experience with clinical protocol design, in particular clinical pharmacology studies.

• Experience in regulatory submissions and health authority interactions including preparation of relevant documents with regards to clinical pharmacology aspects.
 Skills and Competences

• Profound knowledge in PK and PD concepts and their integration into decision making processes of drug development.

• Strong knowledge of state-of-the-art PK and PK/PD modelling and simulation techniques.

• Hands-on experience with PK/PD analysis and modeling software, i.e. Phoenix or equivalent.

• Experience with biologics and small molecules.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements regarding clinical pharmacology.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

• Energetic, driven and able to take initiative with a “can-do attitude”.

• Results and delivery focused as well as a structured way of working.

• Good problem-solving ability and analytical mindset.

• Open, flexible, interested in colleague´s perspectives, team player.

• Strong sense of personal accountability, working independently, as well as a strong ability to work in teams.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Associate Analytical Expert
jobs.description:
About the role
 Join Sobi’s Global CMC Science & Technology team and help shape how our medicines are developed and supplied worldwide. We are looking for an Associate Analytical Expert who will play a key role in ensuring the release of Sobi products by coordination of the stock of Critical Analytical Materials used for the release analyses at our Contract Laboratory Organisations (CLOs). By working cross-functionally with colleagues across Sobi and in close partnership with global contract laboratory organizations (CLOs), you will coordinate and monitor the use of Critical Analytical Materials to ensure continuous availability, re-supply, qualification and effective long-term planning.
 In addition, you will be involved in the day-to-day analytical work supporting our products. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues and gain insight into the business, supply, and lifecycle challenges across our portfolio. Over time, you will build a strong understanding of Sobi’s portfolio and contribute to the continued development of the analytical team.
 This role can be performed remotely within the European time zone and reports to the Group Head of Analytics based at Sobi headquarters in Stockholm.

Key Responsibilities

• Secure continuous control of Critical Analytical Materials needed for release of Sobi products and “tracking” of the use of the stock of the materials.

Examples are Reagents, Standards and Control samples.

• Continuously monitor the stock. Forecast demand, perform stock inventory, create supply plans, order materials, and update stock inventory of critical analytical materials.

• Ensure lifecycle management, compliance, and robustness of Critical Analytical Materials used in analytical methods at CLOs.

• Manage interactions with Sobi’s external partners to ensure continuous delivery of analytical data, protocols, and reports in relation to the Critical Analytical Material.

• Provide analytical expertise across product related activities.

• Contribute to analytical method transfers and support product stability and shelf-life activities through ongoing stability studies.

• Support investigations related to deviations, handling out-of-trend (OOT) and out-of-specification (OOS), as well as handling changes and CAPAs.

• Contribute to identifying, evaluating, and implementing improvements within the analytical team’s ways of working.

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in analytical chemistry, chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy, chemical engineering, or related field.

• Experience of life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Knowledge of common QC laboratory analytical methods, such as chromatography, spectroscopy, ELISA, and bioassays.

• Experience working with contract manufacturers and/or contract laboratories (CMOs/CLOs).

• Interest in automation, digital tools, and visualization of large data sets.

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment.

• Strong written and spoken English skills are required.

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

About the role
Join Sobi’s Global CMC Science & Technology team and help shape how our medicines are developed and supplied worldwide. We are looking for an Associate Analytical Expert who will play a key role in ensuring the release of Sobi products by coordination of the stock of Critical Analytical Materials used for the release analyses at our Contract Laboratory Organisations (CLOs). By working cross-functionally with colleagues across Sobi and in close partnership with global contract laboratory organizations (CLOs), you will coordinate and monitor the use of Critical Analytical Materials to ensure continuous availability, re-supply, qualification and effective long-term planning.
In addition, you will be involved in the day-to-day analytical work supporting our products. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues and gain insight into the business, supply, and lifecycle challenges across our portfolio. Over time, you will build a strong understanding of Sobi’s portfolio and contribute to the continued development of the analytical team.
This role can be performed remotely within the European time zone and reports to the Group Head of Analytics based at Sobi headquarters in Stockholm.

Key Responsibilities

• Secure continuous control of Critical Analytical Materials needed for release of Sobi products and “tracking” of the use of the stock of the materials.

Examples are Reagents, Standards and Control samples.

• Continuously monitor the stock. Forecast demand, perform stock inventory, create supply plans, order materials, and update stock inventory of critical analytical materials.

• Ensure lifecycle management, compliance, and robustness of Critical Analytical Materials used in analytical methods at CLOs.

• Manage interactions with Sobi’s external partners to ensure continuous delivery of analytical data, protocols, and reports in relation to the Critical Analytical Material.

• Provide analytical expertise across product related activities.

• Contribute to analytical method transfers and support product stability and shelf-life activities through ongoing stability studies.

• Support investigations related to deviations, handling out-of-trend (OOT) and out-of-specification (OOS), as well as handling changes and CAPAs.

• Contribute to identifying, evaluating, and implementing improvements within the analytical team’s ways of working.

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in analytical chemistry, chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy, chemical engineering, or related field.

• Experience of life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Knowledge of common QC laboratory analytical methods, such as chromatography, spectroscopy, ELISA, and bioassays.

• Experience working with contract manufacturers and/or contract laboratories (CMOs/CLOs).

• Interest in automation, digital tools, and visualization of large data sets.

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment.

• Strong written and spoken English skills are required.

How to apply
We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
Why Join Us?
Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
The Medicine Development Leader (MDL) has the overall accountability for developing, driving and representing the clinical development strategy for the nephrology program within the Core Asset Team (CAT), including benefit/risk evaluation, pharmacovigilance (PV) and safety. The MDL leads the Medicine Development Team (MDT) and assures, in close collaboration with the TA head, the appropriate communication flow between the CAT, the MDT and other associated teams (e.g. the Study Team).
 Key Responsibilities

• Drives the clinical development strategy for the assigned compound(s) across the medicine lifecycle, from proof of concept to successful global regulatory approval(s)/market access for multiple treatment indications.

• Provides clinical and scientific expertise to set and execute the asset strategy and optimize project success.

• Works with functional members, TA head and CAT Leaders to develop Integrated Project Plans (IPP) documents.

• Identifies risks for the program with other functions and develops mitigation strategies to address them.

• Presents the nephrology clinical program to internal (including the CEO and the Executive Committee of the Organisation) and external stakeholders (Health Authorities, Steering Committees, Independent Data Monitoring Committees, and Patient Organisations etc), engages when necessary with Key Opinion Leaders across geographies.

• Is a core member of the benefit risk team (BRT), of regulatory submission teams and of the labeling working group.

• Ensures endorsement of clinical development plans and study documents by Sobi governance bodies (e.g. Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).

• Leads in a matrix the clinical scientists and the Medicine Development Team (consists of representatives from Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Safety/PV, non-clinical/PK, Biostatistics/Data management, Clinical Program Management, Heath Economics and Outcome Research, RWE, Program Management), providing strategic guidance and being the ultimate accountable for:

• Clinical trial design (clinical study synopsis and protocol development), planning (e.g. sites and countries selection), execution (e.g.medical monitoring, resolution of safety issues; interpretation of statistical analyses) and internal and external communication of study results

• Creation of clinical components of key documents (Clinical Development Plans, Clinical Study Protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory documents including maintenance of product licenses, Clinical Modules of registration dossiers, Briefing Books for interactions with Health Authorities) with high quality and consistency with the Integrated Project Plan and Target Product Profile.

• Provision of required input on clinical efficacy, safety, dosing/administration, mechanism of action, etc for the Target Product Profile (TPP)

• Support to registration and market access (Core Data Sheet, Development Safety Update Report, Periodic Safety Update Report, clinical benefit-risk assessment) o Collaboration with Regulatory team to determine international submission strategy

• Medical degree with 10+ years of relevant clinical experience in academic and/or pharmaceutical Global Research & Development roles

• Solid track record in drug development programmes, preferably within nephrology

• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, global regulatory requirements, and experience in designing and executing clinical studies

• Advanced knowledge of clinical trial operational aspects, including budget and timeline management

• Demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic and tactical plans

• Experience engaging with key internal and external stakeholders

• Specialty in relevant therapeutic area with at least 5 years clinical experience treating patients and successful interactions with major Health Authorities leading to drug approvals

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated capability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment

• Ability to coach, mentor, and communicate effectively with all audiences internally and externally

• Excellent organisational skills with self-motivated drive to implement best practices

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and analyse medical and scientific literature

• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

• Alignment with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership, and Partnership

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:

L'MDL guida il Medicine Development Team (MDT) e assicura, in stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'AT, il flusso di comunicazione appropriato tra CAT, MDT e altri team associati (ad esempio il team di studio). Responsabilità chiave
• Guida la strategia di sviluppo clinico per i composti assegnati attraverso l'intero ciclo di vita del farmaco, dalla prova di concetto all'approvazione normativa globale/accesso al mercato per molteplici indicazioni terapeutiche.
• Fornisce competenze cliniche e scientifiche per impostare ed eseguire la strategia patrimoniale e ottimizzare il successo del progetto.
• Collabora con i membri funzionali, il responsabile AT e i leader CAT per sviluppare documenti di piani di progetto integrati (IPP).
• Identifica i rischi per il programma con altre funzioni e sviluppa strategie di mitigazione per affrontarli.
• Presenta il programma clinico nefrologico alle parti interessate interne (incluso l'amministratore delegato e il comitato esecutivo dell'organizzazione) ed esterne (autorità sanitarie, comitati direttivi, comitati indipendenti di monitoraggio dei dati e organizzazioni di pazienti, ecc.), interagisce, se necessario, con i principali opinion leader in tutte le aree geografiche.
• È un membro fondamentale del team beneficio-rischio (BRT), dei team di presentazione delle normative e del gruppo di lavoro sull'etichettatura.
• Garantisce l'approvazione dei piani di sviluppo clinico e dei documenti di studio da parte degli organi di governo di Sobi (ad esempio Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).
• Dirige in una matrice gli scienziati clinici e il team di sviluppo dei medicinali (composto da rappresentanti di affari medici, scienza clinica, regolamentazione, sicurezza/PV, non clinico/PK, biostatistica/gestione dei dati, gestione del programma clinico, economia sanitaria e ricerca sui risultati, RWE, gestione del programma), fornendo una guida strategica ed essendo il responsabile ultimo di:
• progettazione dello studio clinico (sinossi dello studio clinico e sviluppo del protocollo), pianificazione (ad esempio selezione di siti e paesi), esecuzione (ad esempio monitoraggio medico, risoluzione delle problematiche di sicurezza; interpretazione delle analisi statistiche) e comunicazione interna ed esterna dei risultati dello studio
• Creazione di componenti cliniche di documenti chiave (Piani di sviluppo clinico, Protocolli di studi clinici, Brochure dello sperimentatore, Rapporti di studi clinici, documenti normativi compreso il mantenimento delle licenze dei prodotti, Moduli clinici dei dossier di registrazione, Briefing Book per le interazioni con le Autorità sanitarie) con elevata qualità e coerenza con il Piano di progetto integrato e il Profilo del prodotto target.
• Fornitura degli input richiesti su efficacia clinica, sicurezza, dosaggio/somministrazione, meccanismo d'azione, ecc. per il profilo del prodotto target (TPP)
• Supporto alla registrazione e all'accesso al mercato (scheda dati principale, rapporto di aggiornamento sulla sicurezza dello sviluppo, rapporto di aggiornamento periodico sulla sicurezza, valutazione clinica beneficio-rischio) o Collaborazione con il team di regolamentazione per determinare la strategia di presentazione internazionale
• Laurea in medicina con oltre 10 anni di esperienza clinica rilevante in ruoli accademici e/o farmaceutici di ricerca e sviluppo globali
• Solida esperienza nei programmi di sviluppo di farmaci, preferibilmente in ambito nefrologico
• Conoscenza approfondita della metodologia della sperimentazione clinica, dei requisiti normativi globali ed esperienza nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di studi clinici
• Conoscenza avanzata degli aspetti operativi della sperimentazione clinica, inclusa la gestione del budget e delle tempistiche
• Dimostrata capacità di costruire ed eseguire piani strategici e tattici
• Esperienza nel coinvolgimento di importanti stakeholder interni ed esterni
• Specialità nell'area terapeutica pertinente con almeno 5 anni di esperienza clinica nel trattamento di pazienti e interazioni di successo con le principali autorità sanitarie che portano all'approvazione dei farmaci
• Forti capacità di leadership con capacità dimostrata di guidare team interfunzionali in un ambiente a matrice
• Capacità di istruire, mentore e comunicare in modo efficace con tutto il pubblico internamente ed esternamente
• Eccellenti capacità organizzative con spinta automotivata ad implementare le migliori pratiche
• Capacità dimostrata di valutare e analizzare la letteratura medica e scientifica
• Comunicazione scritta e verbale fluente in inglese
• Allineamento con i valori fondamentali di Sobi: cura, ambizione, urgenza, proprietà e partnership Tutte le tue informazioni saranno mantenute riservate secondo le linee guida EEO.

About the role
 Join Sobi’s Global CMC Science & Technology team and help shape how our medicines are developed and supplied worldwide. We’re hiring an Analytical Science & Technology (Analytics) Expert who will take a leading analytical role across our project and product portfolio. Working cross-functionally with colleagues throughout Sobi—and in close partnership with external contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) globally—you’ll ensure our analytical methods remain compliant, robust, and fit for purpose, while also driving method transfers, validations, and continuous improvements. You’ll coordinate stability studies and support investigations and quality activities (deviations, changes, and CAPAs), acting as an Analytical Subject Matter Expert (SME) to help deliver reliable products to patients.
 This is a remote role located within the European time zone, reporting to Group Head Analytics based in Sobi HQ, Stockholm.
 Key Responsibilities

• Be able to act as Analytics SME taking overall responsibility for analytical methods and analytical related work for the specific product in e.g. the virtual plant teams

• Responsible for analytical method transfers, validations as well as supporting product stability and shelf life through ongoing stability studies

• Establishment and maintenance of reference materials and responsibility for product specific method standards and qualified materials (critical reagents)

• Ensure life cycle management, compliance, robustness, and relevance of analytical methods

• Act as SME in work with regulatory filing, new launches as well as the ongoing work with supply of the commercial products

• Support investigations of deviations, changes and CAPAs, complaints, out of trends (OOT) and out of specifications (OOS)

Qualifications

• MSc/PhD, analytical chemistry/chemistry/biochemistry/pharmacist/chemical engineering or similar

• +5 years of experience of Life Science/Pharma industry with commercial products

• Experience of analysis of biological drugs, validation, analytical tech transfer, stability studies, specifications, handling of reference standards and critical reagents.

• Skilled in common QC methods in the laboratory, e.g. any of HPLC, spectroscopy, ELISA, bioassay

• Experience of working with contract manufacturer with CMOs and CLOs

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
Product-level safety ownership

• Perform and lead signal detection, evaluation, validation and escalation activities for assigned product(s).

• Set the strategy for safety signal detection methodology, signal tracking and oversight of safety signals for assigned products.

• Drive, perform and document benefit‑risk evaluations and ensure appropriate risk‑management strategies are implemented.

• Lead and perform assessments for the preparation, review and approval of key safety deliverables (e.g. PSURs, DSURs, RMPs, regulatory responses).

• Translate safety data insights into actionable recommendations for product‑level benefit–risk discussions and regulatory interactions.

• Lead the clinical safety science interactions with partner companies for the assigned products (if applicable) ensuring sharing of safety information per the SDEA and the set up and collaborative functioning of the JSMT.

• Provide safety scientific input to ISS Evaluation Committee as required.

• In case of product quality escalations, work cross functionally to understand impacts on patients, and (if required) lead the preparation of a medical impact Health Hazard Assessment statement.

Cross-functional execution (MDT)

• Act as the Safety Science representative in the Medical Development Team (MDT) and ensure integration of safety into product development and lifecycle decisions.

• Provide clinical safety input into study design, conduct, analysis and interpretation, including study‑level Safety Lead responsibilities where applicable.

• Provide medical and pharmacovigilance expertise e.g. for the clinical safety strategy of the product clinical development program, the development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), the development and maintenance of the RSI, including IB and CDS

Governance and decision-making

• Chair product‑level Benefit Risk Teams (BRTs) and ensure effective operation per SOPs.

• Represent the BRT at Benefit Risk Council (BRC).

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for product-level safety issues, including signal validation and escalation.

Collaboration and delivery

• Lead interactions with external partners and service providers related to assigned product safety deliverables.

• Support regulatory interactions, inspections and audits at product level.

People and capability development

• Mentor colleagues and support capability development within the product safety team.

Continuous improvement & data-driven decision making

• Actively use and continuously develop proficiency in safety systems, data visualization tools, and AI‑enabled analyses (e.g. Veeva Vault(s), analytics dashboards) to support robust and efficient signal detection, safety assessments, and decision‑making for assigned products.

• Identify opportunities for process, data and system improvements within Safety Science.

Level of autonomy: works independently with accountability for assigned products, escalating complex or cross‑product issues as appropriate.

Education/Learning Experience/Work Experience
 Required:

• MD, PharmD, PhD or Master’s in Life Sciences/Public Health

• Solid experience in pharmacovigilance and safety science within a pharmaceutical or regulatory environment

• Strong knowledge of global PV regulations (e.g., GVP, ICH E2E), pharmacovigilance processes and practices

• Proficiency to analyse, synthesize medical & scientific safety data and contribute to scientific interpretation

• Strong communication & stakeholder collaboration skills

• Proficiency in Excel, database querying (e.g., SQL), and basic data visualization (e.g., Power BI, Spotfire), AI-related tools

• Experience working with development programs and with products with market approvals

• Experience leading cross functional global product safety management teams, successfully delivering medical safety strategy, with experience across safety signal process, aggregate report writing, safety risk communication and safety risk management

Desired:

• Experience working with partner companies to successfully develop and market products across global markets

• Experience presenting medical safety information at Health Authority meetings

• Demonstrated expertise in the understanding, interpretation, and application of various country/regional pharmacovigilance requirements

Skills/Knowledge/Languages
 Required:

• High quality written and spoken English

• Strong analytical skills

• Effective communicator (oral, writing, presentations) at all levels of the business

• Ability to work effectively to fulfil ambitious goals

• Sound and balanced judgment skills; able to assess and handle risks; self-confident, proactive and decisive

• Demonstrated ability to lead safety activities and scientific discussions

• Strong team-leadership capabilities. Demonstrated relationship builder both internally and externally; a strong collaborator within PV function, leadership and the wider organisation

• Fornire input di sicurezza clinica nella progettazione, nella condotta, nell'analisi e nell'interpretazione, comprese le responsabilità del piombo di sicurezza a livello di studio ove applicabile.
• Fornire competenze mediche e farmacovigilanza, ad esempio per la strategia di sicurezza clinica del programma di sviluppo clinico del prodotto, lo sviluppo del profilo del prodotto target (TPP), lo sviluppo e la manutenzione del RSI, tra cui IB e CDS Governance e processo decisionale
• Sedia a livello di prodotto Benefit Risk Teams (BRTs) e garantire un funzionamento efficace per le SOP.
• Rappresentare la BRT al Benefit Risk Council (BRC).
• Servire come primo decisore per problemi di sicurezza a livello di prodotto, tra cui la convalida del segnale e l'escalation. Collaborazione e consegna
• Interazioni di piombo con partner esterni e fornitori di servizi relativi ai fornitori di sicurezza dei prodotti assegnati.
• Supporta interazioni, ispezioni e audit normativi a livello di prodotto. Sviluppo delle persone e delle capacità
• Collaboratori e sviluppo delle capacità di supporto all'interno del team di sicurezza del prodotto. Miglioramento continuo e processo decisionale basato sui dati
• Utilizzare attivamente e sviluppare continuamente la competenza nei sistemi di sicurezza, negli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati e nelle analisi abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale (ad esempio Veeva Vault(s), dashboard di analisi) per supportare il rilevamento dei segnali robusti ed efficienti, le valutazioni di sicurezza e il processo decisionale per i prodotti assegnati.
• Identificare le opportunità per i miglioramenti di processo, dati e sistemi all'interno di Safety Science. Livello di autonomia: funziona in modo indipendente con responsabilità per i prodotti assegnati, aumentando i problemi complessi o cross-product come appropriato. Esperienza di formazione/apprendimento/esperienza di lavoro Richiesto:
• MD, PharmD, PhD o Master in Scienze della Vita / Salute Pubblica
• Esperienza solida nella farmacovigilanza e nella scienza della sicurezza in un ambiente farmaceutico o normativo
• Forte conoscenza delle normative PV globali (ad esempio, GVP, ICH E2E), processi e pratiche di farmacovigilanza
• Capacità di analizzare, sintetizzare dati di sicurezza medica e scientifica e contribuire all'interpretazione scientifica
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione degli stakeholder
• Proficienza in Excel, querying del database (ad esempio, SQL) e visualizzazione dei dati di base (ad esempio, Power BI, Spotfire), strumenti correlati all'AI
• Esperienza di lavoro con programmi di sviluppo e con prodotti con approvazioni di mercato
• Esperienza leader tra i team di gestione della sicurezza dei prodotti globali funzionali, offrendo con successo la strategia di sicurezza medica, con esperienza nel processo di segnale di sicurezza, scrittura di report aggregati, comunicazione dei rischi di sicurezza e gestione dei rischi di sicurezza Desired:
• Esperienza di lavoro con le aziende partner per sviluppare e commercializzare con successo prodotti su mercati globali
• Esperienza che presenta informazioni sulla sicurezza medica alle riunioni dell'Autorità sanitaria
• Competenza dimostrata nella comprensione, nell'interpretazione e nell'applicazione dei vari requisiti di farmacovigilanza nazionale/regionale Competenze/Knowledge/Languages Richiesto:
• Alta qualità scritto e parlato inglese
• Forte capacità analitiche
• Efficace comunicatore (orale, scrittura, presentazioni) a tutti i livelli del business
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente per raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi
• Competenze di giudizio solide ed equilibrate; capaci di valutare e gestire i rischi; autosufficienti, proattive e decisive
• Capacità dimostrata di condurre attività di sicurezza e discussioni scientifiche
• Forte capacità di team-leadership. Dimostrato costruttore di relazioni sia internamente che esternamente; un forte collaboratore all'interno della funzione PV, della leadership e dell'organizzazione più ampia

jobs.description:
Sobi is currently seeking a R&D and Medical Affairs (RDMA) Strategy and Portfolio Associate Director to join our RDMA Strategy and Operations (S&O) group. The position owns the development, execution, and continuous evolution of RDMA strategy and portfolio insights, acting as a thought partner to senior RDMA leadership. The position plays a central role in shaping portfolio‑level decisions, advancing digital and AI‑enabled capabilities, and strengthening RDMA governance and decision‑making.
 Main responsibilities:

• Partner with Head of RDMA S&O to define and implement RDMA strategy

• Lead the definition and execution of the RDMA digital and AI roadmap

• Shape and continuously improve RDMA operating model, governance, and decision processes

• Translate portfolio data into clear, decision‑ready insights for RDMA LT, ExCom, and Portfolio Review Committees

• Act as RDMA strategy lead in BD scouting and due diligence, ensuring consistency, comparability, and strategic fit

• Drive preparation of high‑impact materials for senior governance forums

• Experience in portfolio management, R&D strategy, or enterprise‑level analytics within Pharma/Biotech

• Proven ability to synthesize complex data into executive‑level insights and recommendations

• Experience working with senior governance bodies (LT, ExCom, Portfolio Committees)

• Exposure to BD, due diligence, or asset evaluation strongly preferred

• Familiarity with R&D digital tools, portfolio systems, or analytics platforms is an advantage

• Life Science MSc or completed Medicine degree

• Professional proficiency in English

• Ability to solve complex problems, develop creative solutions, thinking dexterity

• Self-awareness, open-minded, courageous, solid ownership mindset, purpose and integrity, persist and sustain energy as well as authenticity and empathy are personal traits that will make you successful in this role

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team

• Opportunità di crescita professionale

• Diversità e inclusione

Siamo una società globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in oltre 30 paesi e siamo impegnati nelle società in cui operiamo. Con un team di gestione profondamente qualificato che dirige le nostre vincite quotidiane, e un Board con un record di traccia stellare, siamo pronti a prendere le malattie del mondo, disturbi e avversità. La nostra gente crede di avere il potere di avere un impatto positivo nella vita degli altri perché è esattamente ciò che facciamo qui. Se siete alla ricerca di una carriera che tocca i vostri talenti in un modo che rende il mondo un posto migliore, più sano, possiamo solo avere un lavoro per voi.

A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli.

Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo obiettivo come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che li curano. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. L'integrazione richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile.

Warum mitmachen?

Sobikultur

Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen für Menschen, die von seltenen Krankheiten betroffen sind, aus erster Hand miterlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Geschäft zu gestalten, um neue Wege zu finden, ihnen zu helfen.

Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen verwandeln, helfen wir, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Möglichkeiten für diejenigen zu eröffnen, die sich um sie kümmern. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Stakeholdern entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

• Traduire les données du portefeuille en renseignements clairs et prêts à prendre des décisions pour les comités d'examen de la LT, du Comité exécutif et du Portefeuille de l'AMRC

• Agir en tant que chef de file de la stratégie de l'AMRD en matière de dépistage et de diligence raisonnable, en assurant la cohérence, la comparabilité et l'adéquation stratégique

• Encourager la préparation de documents à fort impact pour les forums de gouvernance senior

• Capacité éprouvée de synthétiser des données complexes dans des idées et des recommandations de la direction

• Expérience de travail avec les organes de gouvernance supérieurs (LT, Comité exécutif, Comités de portefeuille)

• Exposition à la DB, à la diligence raisonnable ou à l'évaluation des biens fortement préférée

• La connaissance des outils numériques de R-D, des systèmes de portefeuille ou des plateformes d'analyse est un avantage

• Capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes, développer des solutions créatives, penser dextérité

• La conscience de soi, l'ouverture d'esprit, le courage, l'esprit de propriété solide, le but et l'intégrité, persistent et maintiennent l'énergie ainsi que l'authenticité et l'empathie sont des traits personnels qui vous feront réussir dans ce rôle

• Mettre l'accent sur l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

• Environnement collaboratif et axé sur l'équipe

• Possibilités de croissance professionnelle

• Diversité et inclusion

• Compensation compétitive pour votre travail

• Répercussions positives pour aider les patients atteints de maladies ultra-rares qui ont besoin de traitements vitaux
Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale avec plus de 1 900 employés dans plus de 30 pays et sommes engagés dans les sociétés où nous opérons. Avec une équipe de gestion profondément qualifiée dirigeant nos victoires quotidiennes, et un conseil avec un bilan stellaire, nous sommes prêts à prendre sur le monde des maladies, des maladies et de l'adversité. Notre peuple croit qu'il a le pouvoir d'avoir un impact positif sur les autres, parce que c'est exactement ce que nous faisons ici. Ensemble, nous définissons comment notre entreprise peut créer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des personnes touchées par des maladies rares tout en facilitant une croissance durable.
